Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter i: Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter instance controls one TV.
Enter the TV's IP address or hostname wi: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname without http:// or a port. A fixed IP address is recommended.
Enter the TV's IP address or hostname.
Limits direct volume commands to this TV: Limits direct volume commands to this TV level. Remote control buttons and changes made on the TV are not limited.
MAC address of the TV's wired network in: MAC address of the TV's wired network interface, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
Enter a MAC address or leave this field: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.
MAC address of the TV's wireless network: MAC address of the TV's wireless network interface. Waking up over Wi-Fi depends on the TV.
Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.
Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a d: Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a different port.
Maximum time to wait for an answer to on: Maximum time to wait for an answer to one TV request.
Leave enabled to use the request format: Leave enabled to use the request format of Loewe App 1.4.7.
0 disables automatic status queries, inc: 0 disables automatic status queries, including the initial query at startup. Otherwise, enter 5 to 3600 seconds. Manual commands remain available.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600: Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600.
Include current playback in status queri: Include current playback in status queries. Disable this if the TV does not support the playback query.
With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also t: With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also tries a matching local network broadcast when the TV address is IPv4. A different address entered here is used as specified.
Enable Quick Start and network wake-up o: Enable Quick Start and network wake-up on the TV. Without Quick Start, the TV may shut down its network functions in standby and then require the remote control to turn on. Enter the TV's MAC address for the first test and wait at least 30 seconds after switching to standby. The adapter sends Wake-on-LAN, then the TV-on command.
Maximum time for waking the network serv: Maximum time for waking the network service and sending the dedicated TV-on command. The attempt stops when this limit is reached.
Enter a whole number from 5 to 120.
info.wakeReady shows whether a MAC addre: info.wakeReady shows whether a MAC address is known. info.lastWakeOnLan records packet transmission. info.powerOn shows the current attempt and its result; successful transmission does not confirm a visible picture.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 60 to 864: Enter 0 or a whole number from 60 to 86400.
Refresh the complete selected TV channel: Refresh the complete selected TV channel list automatically. Default: 300 seconds. 0 disables automatic channel refresh. Manual refresh remains available.
Turn on the TV and start the adapter to: Turn on the TV and start the adapter to load the available channel lists. Save changes to the TV address or control port first. Then reopen this configuration or use Reload channel lists.
Only TV stations from this list are crea: Only TV stations from this list are created under channels.tv. An empty selection creates no TV station objects. Save the selection to apply it.
Read the current and next programme dire: Read the current and next programme directly from the TV and show them under each selected TV channel.
Default: 900 seconds. Enter 0 or 300 to: Default: 900 seconds. Enter 0 or 300 to 86400 seconds. 0 disables automatic EPG network requests, including at startup. With EPG enabled, channels.epgRefresh still refreshes manually.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 300 to 86: Enter 0 or a whole number from 300 to 86400.
